name: Catppuccin Frappé
description: Soft muted dark theme balancing warmth and cool undertones
author: Catppuccin Org
left_toml:
"$schema" = 'https://starship.rs/config-schema.json'
format = "$custom"
add_newline = false

[custom.prefix_active]
when = 'test "${TMUX_CLIENT_PREFIX:-0}" = "1"'
command = 'printf "󰇄 %s" "${TMUX_SESSION_NAME:-tmux}"'
format = "[$output]($style) "
style = "bg:#81c8be fg:#232634 bold"

[custom.session_normal]
when = 'test "${TMUX_CLIENT_PREFIX:-0}" != "1"'
command = 'printf "󰇄 %s" "${TMUX_SESSION_NAME:-tmux}"'
format = "[$output]($style) "
style = "fg:#737994"
center_toml:
format = "$custom"
add_newline = false

[custom.window_active]
when = 'test "${TMUX_WINDOW_ACTIVE:-0}" = "1"'
command = 'printf "%s:%s" "${TMUX_WINDOW_INDEX:-1}" "${TMUX_WINDOW_NAME:-sh}"'
format = "[$output]($style)"
style = "bg:#414559 fg:#c6d0f5 bold"

[custom.window_inactive]
when = 'test "${TMUX_WINDOW_ACTIVE:-0}" != "1"'
command = 'printf "%s:%s" "${TMUX_WINDOW_INDEX:-1}" "${TMUX_WINDOW_NAME:-sh}"'
format = "[$output]($style)"
style = "fg:#737994"

[custom.window_zoom]
when = 'test "${TMUX_WINDOW_ACTIVE:-0}" = "1" && test "${TMUX_WINDOW_ZOOMED_FLAG:-0}" = "1"'
command = 'printf "🔍"'
format = " $output"
style = "fg:#e5c890"
right_toml:
"$schema" = 'https://starship.rs/config-schema.json'
format = "$time$custom"
add_newline = false

[time]
disabled = false
format = "[$time]($style) "
style = "fg:#8caaee"
time_format = "%H:%M:%S"

[custom.host]
when = "true"
shell = "bash"
command = 'printf "%s" "${TMUX_HOST_SHORT:-$(hostname -s)}"'
format = "on [$output]($style) "
style = "fg:#a6d189"

[custom.window_count]
when = "true"
shell = "bash"
command = 'printf "%s" "${TMUX_SESSION_WINDOWS:-1}"'
format = "[󰖲 $output]($style)"
style = "fg:#ca9ee6"
full_toml:
"$schema" = 'https://starship.rs/config-schema.json'
format = "$custom$time"
add_newline = false

[custom.prefix_active]
when = 'test "${TMUX_CLIENT_PREFIX:-0}" = "1"'
command = 'printf "󰇄 %s" "${TMUX_SESSION_NAME:-tmux}"'
format = "[$output]($style) "
style = "bg:#81c8be fg:#232634 bold"

[custom.session_normal]
when = 'test "${TMUX_CLIENT_PREFIX:-0}" != "1"'
command = 'printf "󰇄 %s" "${TMUX_SESSION_NAME:-tmux}"'
format = "[$output]($style) "
style = "fg:#737994"

[time]
disabled = false
format = "[$time]($style) "
style = "fg:#8caaee"
time_format = "%H:%M:%S"

author: Arctic Ice Studio
left_toml:

[custom.session_normal]
when = 'test "${TMUX_CLIENT_PREFIX:-0}" != "1"'
command = 'printf "󰇄 %s" "${TMUX_SESSION_NAME:-tmux}"'
format = "[$output]($style) "
style = "fg:#4c566a"

[custom.window_inactive]

name: Tokyo Night Moon
description: Dark blue hue variant of Tokyo Night with midnight aesthetics
author: Tokyo Night
left_toml:
"$schema" = 'https://starship.rs/config-schema.json'
format = "$custom"
add_newline = false

[custom.prefix_active]
when = 'test "${TMUX_CLIENT_PREFIX:-0}" = "1"'
command = 'printf "󰇄 %s" "${TMUX_SESSION_NAME:-tmux}"'
format = "[$output]($style) "
style = "bg:#82aaff fg:#1e2030 bold"

[custom.session_normal]
when = 'test "${TMUX_CLIENT_PREFIX:-0}" != "1"'
command = 'printf "󰇄 %s" "${TMUX_SESSION_NAME:-tmux}"'
format = "[$output]($style) "
style = "fg:#636da6"
center_toml:
format = "$custom"
add_newline = false

[custom.window_active]
when = 'test "${TMUX_WINDOW_ACTIVE:-0}" = "1"'
command = 'printf "%s:%s" "${TMUX_WINDOW_INDEX:-1}" "${TMUX_WINDOW_NAME:-sh}"'
format = "[$output]($style)"
style = "bg:#2d3f76 fg:#c8d3f5 bold"

[custom.window_inactive]
when = 'test "${TMUX_WINDOW_ACTIVE:-0}" != "1"'
command = 'printf "%s:%s" "${TMUX_WINDOW_INDEX:-1}" "${TMUX_WINDOW_NAME:-sh}"'
format = "[$output]($style)"
style = "fg:#636da6"

[custom.window_zoom]
when = 'test "${TMUX_WINDOW_ACTIVE:-0}" = "1" && test "${TMUX_WINDOW_ZOOMED_FLAG:-0}" = "1"'
command = 'printf "🔍"'
format = " $output"
style = "fg:#ffc777"
right_toml:
"$schema" = 'https://starship.rs/config-schema.json'
format = "$time$custom"
add_newline = false

[time]
disabled = false
format = "[$time]($style) "
style = "fg:#4fd6be"
time_format = "%H:%M:%S"

[custom.host]
when = "true"
shell = "bash"
command = 'printf "%s" "${TMUX_HOST_SHORT:-$(hostname -s)}"'
format = "on [$output]($style) "
style = "fg:#c3e88d"

[custom.window_count]
when = "true"
shell = "bash"
command = 'printf "%s" "${TMUX_SESSION_WINDOWS:-1}"'
format = "[󰖲 $output]($style)"
style = "fg:#fca7ea"
full_toml:
"$schema" = 'https://starship.rs/config-schema.json'
format = "$custom$time"
add_newline = false

[custom.prefix_active]
when = 'test "${TMUX_CLIENT_PREFIX:-0}" = "1"'

format = "[$output]($style) "
style = "bg:#82aaff fg:#1e2030 bold"

[custom.session_normal]
when = 'test "${TMUX_CLIENT_PREFIX:-0}" != "1"'
command = 'printf "󰇄 %s" "${TMUX_SESSION_NAME:-tmux}"'
format = "[$output]($style) "
style = "fg:#636da6"

[time]
disabled = false
format = "[$time]($style) "
style = "fg:#4fd6be"
time_format = "%H:%M:%S"
